text:
## Customer Fraud Reporting  
### Reporting Procedure  
**1. Customer Reports Suspected Fraud**
- Via: Phone (0800-555-2265), email, branch, online
- Capture: Full details, timeline, amounts  
**2. Immediate Actions**
- Acknowledge report
- Freeze account (if account takeover)
- Block affected card (if card fraud)
- Escalate to Financial Crime team
- Provide temporary access (alternate card/account)  
**3. Investigation (24–48 hours)**
- Review transaction details
- Assess fraud likelihood
- Check payment status
- Determine liability
- Document findings  
**4. Reimbursement Decision**
- **If Fraud Confirmed:** Full reimbursement within 10 days
- **If Not Fraud:** Explain reasoning, educate customer
- **If Disputed:** Escalate to Head of Financial Crime + follow-up

raw_entities.name: Customer Fraud Reporting Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the process by which customers report suspected fraud, the bank's immediate response actions, investigation procedures, and reimbursement decisions. Establishes timelines for investigation (24–48 hours) and reimbursement (within 10 days if fraud is confirmed).

raw_entities.name: Customer Fraud Report Submission
raw_entities.description: Customers must be able to report suspected fraud via multiple channels: phone (0800-555-2265), email, branch, or online. Full details, timeline, and amounts must be captured.

raw_entities.name: Immediate Account Freeze on Account Takeover
raw_entities.description: Upon receipt of a customer fraud report involving account takeover, the account must be frozen immediately as part of the response protocol.

raw_entities.name: Immediate Card Block on Card Fraud
raw_entities.description: Upon receipt of a customer fraud report involving card fraud, the affected card must be blocked immediately as part of the response protocol.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Report Escalation to Financial Crime Team
raw_entities.description: All customer fraud reports must be escalated to the Financial Crime team as part of the immediate response procedure.

raw_entities.name: Temporary Access Provision During Fraud Investigation
raw_entities.description: Customers reporting fraud must be provided with temporary access to funds or services via an alternate card or account while the investigation is ongoing.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Completion Timeline
raw_entities.description: Fraud investigations must be completed within 24–48 hours, including review of transaction details, fraud likelihood assessment, payment status check, liability determination, and documentation of findings.

raw_entities.name: Confirmed Fraud Reimbursement Obligation
raw_entities.description: When fraud is confirmed following investigation, the customer must receive full reimbursement within 10 days.
context: If Fraud Confirmed: Full reimbursement within 10 days

raw_entities.name: Non-Fraud Finding Communication and Education
raw_entities.description: When investigation determines the reported transaction is not fraud, the bank must explain the reasoning to the customer and provide education.
context: If Not Fraud: Explain reasoning, educate customer

raw_entities.name: Disputed Fraud Finding Escalation
raw_entities.description: When a customer disputes the fraud investigation finding, the matter must be escalated to the Head of Financial Crime with follow-up action.
context: If Disputed: Escalate to Head of Financial Crime + follow-up

raw_entities.name: Account Takeover
raw_entities.description: A fraud scenario in which an unauthorized party gains control of a customer's account, triggering immediate account freeze and investigation procedures.

raw_entities.name: Card Fraud
raw_entities.description: A fraud scenario involving unauthorized use of a customer's payment card, triggering immediate card block and investigation procedures.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Report Acknowledgment
raw_entities.description: Immediate acknowledgment of customer fraud reports upon receipt, establishing the start of the investigation and response process.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Detail Review
raw_entities.description: Detailed review of transaction records as part of the fraud investigation process to assess the validity of the customer's fraud claim.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Likelihood Assessment
raw_entities.description: Evaluation of the likelihood that reported transactions constitute fraud, based on investigation findings and transaction patterns.

raw_entities.name: Payment Status Verification
raw_entities.description: Verification of the status of payments involved in the reported fraud to determine whether funds have been settled or can be recovered.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Liability Determination
raw_entities.description: Assessment and determination of liability for the fraudulent transaction, establishing whether the bank or customer bears responsibility.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Documentation
raw_entities.description: Comprehensive documentation of all fraud investigation findings, decisions, and supporting evidence for audit and compliance purposes.

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Team
raw_entities.description: The team responsible for receiving escalated fraud reports from customer-facing staff and conducting the investigation into suspected fraud within the defined 24–48 hour timeframe.

raw_entities.name: Head of Financial Crime
raw_entities.description: Senior role responsible for escalation and final decision-making in disputed fraud cases where the customer contests the investigation outcome.
context: Escalate to Head of Financial Crime + follow-up

raw_entities.name: Customer Fraud Report
raw_entities.description: The formal process initiated when a customer reports suspected fraud via phone, email, branch, or online channels, triggering immediate response actions and investigation.

raw_entities.name: Confirmed Fraud Reimbursement
raw_entities.description: The outcome of a fraud investigation where fraud is confirmed, resulting in full reimbursement to the customer within 10 days.
context: If Fraud Confirmed: Full reimbursement within 10 days

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: The individual customer who reports suspected fraud and is the subject of the investigation and reimbursement decision process.

raw_entities.name: Debit Card
raw_entities.description: A payment card issued to a customer that may be subject to fraud and blocked immediately upon report of card fraud.

raw_entities.name: Customer Account
raw_entities.description: A customer account that may be subject to account takeover fraud and is frozen immediately upon such report, with temporary access provided via alternate means.
